section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 7. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 165 | 650 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Side effects | 223 | 650 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 171 | 650 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Side effects | 95 | 650 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
